omniresonance.inventory.title: Resonance domain
omniresonance.inventory.search_help:
Name, @mod, #tag, $tooltip, *ID, type:item/fluid/energy. Spaces: AND, |: OR, !: exclude, quotes: phrase. Right-click clears.
Storage: left takes/fills; right takes half or empties a carried container, including on blank space. Shift uses a full carrier. Shift-click inventory items to deposit.
Shift-click storage: take a stack into inventory. Shift-click inventory: deposit that stack. Shift-double-click inventory: deposit all matching stacks.
